reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is two capsules every single day. The lab report and the guarantee are nice, but they don't fix the pills.
objection: Two capsules to swallow every day. I'd quit by day four and have 26 sachets left over.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or powder drink version of the same magnesium with the same lab report.
